app.title: PDF TOOLS
app.description: PDF tools for processing documents locally.
app.metaDescription: Merge, extract, delete, and reorder PDF pages locally.
app.privacy: Temporary files are deleted after each operation.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine multiple PDF documents in the order you choose.

extract.title: Extract pages
extract.description: Keep only the pages you need.

delete.title: Delete pages
delete.description: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF document.

reorder.title: Reorder pages
reorder.description: Drag the thumbnails to change the order of the pages.

files.dropDescription: or browse files on your computer
files.dropMultipleDescription: Click to browse and add multiple files
files.singleOnly: Select one PDF file for this operation.

merge.stepFilesDescription: Documents will be combined in the order shown.
merge.stepOutputDescription: A single PDF will be downloaded automatically.
merge.privacy: Files are sent to the local server only when you merge them.
merge.minimumFiles: Add at least two PDF files to merge.

pages.extractDescription: The new PDF will contain only the pages you specify.
pages.deleteDescription: The PDF must keep at least one page.
pages.help: Separate page numbers with commas or use ranges, for example 1,3,7 or 2-4,8.
pages.privacy: Files are sent to the local server for processing, then temporary files are deleted.

reorder.stepFileDescription: Thumbnails are generated in your browser.
reorder.dropDescription: The file is sent to the server only after you confirm the order.
reorder.stepPagesDescription: Drag pages or use the keyboard to move them.
reorder.previewFailed: Could not create thumbnails for this PDF.
reorder.canvasUnavailable: This browser cannot generate page thumbnails.
reorder.selectAndWait: Select a PDF and wait for thumbnails to finish loading.

apiErrors.emptyPdf: The generated PDF file is empty.
apiErrors.networkError: Could not reach the local server.

apiErrors.unexpectedField: The form contains an unexpected field.
apiErrors.fieldTooLarge: A form field is too large.
apiErrors.unexpectedFile: The form contains an unexpected file.
apiErrors.singleFileOnly: Only one PDF file is accepted for this operation.
apiErrors.fileTooLarge: Each PDF file must be no larger than 250 MB.
apiErrors.mergeMinimumFiles: Select at least two PDF files.
apiErrors.workspaceFailed: Could not create a temporary processing workspace.
apiErrors.readFailed: Could not read the processed PDF.
apiErrors.invalidSelection: Check the selected pages and files.

apiErrors.prepareFailed: Could not prepare the PDF files.
